patchouli.dandao.book.entry.processing.t: All herbs can be processed in a Smoker. After processing, the medicinal property level of the herb increases by 1
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.mortar.name: Mortar (Herb-Grinding)
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.mortar.text: Used to grind minerals into mineral powder, which helps to activate the medicinal properties of materials (medicinal property level +1)
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.iron_mill.te: Used to grind medicinal materials into Medicinal Powder$(br2)Note: At least one herb and one mineral (or mineral powder) are required to make Medicinal Powder (excluding Medicinal Powder itself)$(br2)Operation Method: Place the required ingredients into the left input slot, close the menu, and hold the Shift key while right-clicking the Iron Herb Grinder repeatedly to start grinding
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.kneading_boa: Used to combine Medicinal Powder into Elixir Embryos$(br2)Crafting requires two portions of Medicinal Powder and one bottle of water-based liquid$(br)$(li)Regular Water Bottle: No additional effect$(li)Honey Bottle: Offsets the impact of conflicting medicinal properties$(li)Dragon's Breath: Maximizes the medicinal properties$()$(br2)Usage Method: Place the required ingredients into the left input slot, close the menu, hold the Shift key and right-click the block, and wait for the animation to complete to obtain the Elixir Embryo
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.whisk.name: Taoist Whisk
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.whisk.text: Required for constructing the Alchemy Furnace and implementing some other functions
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.reactor.name: Alchemy Reactor
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.reactor.text: A necessary block for constructing the Alchemy Furnace
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.incense_burn: A block for convenient timing; insert an Incense Stick and light it to start timing$(br2)One incense stick burns for approximately 1 minute in real time$(br2)Right-click the Incense Burner with a Taoist Whisk to subscribe to notifications, which will be displayed in the chat box at each burning stage. Each player can subscribe to at most one Incense Burner
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.incense_stic: Incense used in the Incense Burner; a consumable item$(br2)Usage Method: Hold the Incense Stick and right-click the Incense Burner to insert it (max 3 sticks at a time). Hold Shift + right-click with an empty hand to remove it, and use a Flint and Steel to light it
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.bamboo_sieve: A tool for making Water Pills$(br2)Usage Method: Hold Shift + right-click to open the menu, place the corresponding materials according to the recipe requirements, close the menu, and hold the right-click to start crafting
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.alchemy_furn: Used to refine Elixir Embryos into finished elixirs; constructed with 7 Iron Ingots, 1 Magma Block, and 1 Alchemy Reactor

Regardless of the orientation, the Alchemy Reactor must have the Tai Chi diagram face exposed. After completing the structure, right-click the Alchemy Reactor with a Taoist Whisk to activate the Alchemy Furnace

$(l)Temperature: $()Each type of elixir requires a different temperature, with a total of four temperature levels$(li)$(#FFFF00)Level 1: 0-100$()$(li)$(#FF0000)Level 2: 101-200$()$(li)$(#5F9EA0)Level 3: 201-300$()$(li)$(#9370DB)Level 4: 301-400$()$(br2)When opening the furnace, pay attention to whether the temperature is within the specified level; otherwise, elixir refining will fail. After each refining, the temperature will drop to half of its original value

$(l)Success Rate: $()Refining elixirs is not always successful; the base success rate is 30%, which is affected by Luck and the Alchemist's Insight effect$(br2)$(l)Time: $()Each type of elixir requires a different refining time. The furnace must be opened at the specific time point (a 15-second error margin is allowed); note that exceeding 5 minutes will cause the furnace to explode

$(l)Usage Method: $()Right-click the Alchemy Furnace to open the menu. The 4 slots on the right are fuel slots, and the 8 slots in the Eight Trigrams diagram on the left are input slots. It is recommended to preheat the temperature to the specified level first, then place the Elixir Embryos that match the recipe, and click the "Close Furnace" button. When white smoke emerges from the furnace, refining has started$(br)Note: When black smoke is seen, it means the furnace has been closed for more than 3 minutes; open the furnace as soon as possible to avoid an explosion$(br2)Hold Shift and right-click the Alchemy Furnace with a Taoist Whisk to quickly open/close it
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.heat.name: Heating
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.heat.text: Different fuels have different combustion efficiencies. After combustion, fuel first fills the heat bar (yellow energy bar), and then every 10 heat points are converted into 1 temperature point$(br2)$(li)1 Heat Point: Carpets, Sticks, etc.$(li)2 Heat Points: Bookshelves, Chests, etc.$(li)4 Heat Points: Hanging Signs$(li)6 Heat Points: Boats$(li)20 Heat Points: Coal, Charcoal$(li)50 Heat Points: Blaze Rods$(li)80 Heat Points: Coal Blocks$(li)100 Heat Points: Lava Buckets
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.cooling.name: Cooling
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.cooling.text: The Alchemy Furnace can cool down naturally. When the heat bar is 0, the temperature decreases by approximately 1 point every 15 seconds; after closing the furnace, it decreases by 1 point every 5 seconds$(br2)You can also place cooling materials in the fuel slots to cool down quickly. At this time, the heat bar will be filled with blue energy, and each 1 cooling point reduces the temperature by 1 point$(li)20 Cooling Points: Water Bottles, Snowballs$(li)50 Cooling Points: Snow Blocks, Powder Snow Buckets$(li)100 Cooling Points: Water Buckets, Ice Blocks
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.putuan.name: Meditation Cushion
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.putuan.text: A decorative block; right-click to sit on it. It may have additional uses in the future
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.herbalist.te: A new villager profession. Place an Iron Herb Grinder in a village to convert a villager into a Herbalist, who sells various herbs and minerals
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.command.name: Commands

A set of clothing essential for alchemists and cultivators, which greatly increases the success rate of elixir refining
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.fu_ti_dan.te: This elixir is specially used to heal severe injuries. Due to its mild medicinal properties, it will not cause any additional damage to the already injured body, making it an excellent elixir for treating severe wounds
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.bi_gu_dan.te: This elixir is specially designed to solve the need for food. After taking it, you can go for weeks without eating a single grain or vegetable while remaining energetic, making it a powerful assistant for long journeys or focused cultivation
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.fan_ming_dan: This elixir is most effective at preserving the soul. Once taken, it can withstand lethal attacks, serving as a lifesaver in desperate situations$(br2)$(effect)Soul Lock: $()During the effect duration, the player can avoid one death. The effect disappears after triggering, similar to a Totem of Undying
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.feng_xing_da: This elixir is specially made to increase movement speed. After taking it, your body moves as fast as the wind, making it a powerful tool for traveling or chasing/escaping
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.hui_chun_dan: This elixir has powerful medicinal effects. After taking it, you can instantly restore your vitality, and even broken bones can be immediately regenerated. It is truly a miracle medicine that can pull you back from the brink of death
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.huo_huan_dan: This elixir is most effective at resisting fire damage. After taking it, no matter how fierce the fire is, it cannot harm you at all, makingit an invaluable protective treasure for traversing fire-filled areas
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.ji_yun_dan.t: This elixir can channel the power of wind. After taking it, you can control qi to ride the wind and soar freely between heaven and earth, making it a rare item that breaks the shackles of the ground$(br2)$(effect)Flight: $()Allows flight like in Creative Mode
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.jie_du_dan.t: This elixir is most skilled at neutralizing all kinds of poisons in the world. After taking it, it not only dispels toxins in the body but also grants immunity to all poisons, making it a wonderful protective medicine for traveling through dangerous areas
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.jin_huan_dan: This elixir is most effective at tempering the body. After taking it, you gain an indestructible golden body, like wearing an unbreakable golden armor. Even sword strikes and blade cuts can hardly harm you, making it an excellent treasure for self-defense and combat
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.jiu_si_po_yu: Jiu Si Po Yuan Dan (Nine-Deaths Origin-Breaking Elixir)

This elixir can stimulate human potential. In life-threatening situations, it allows people to unleash incomparably powerful strength, making it a domineering weapon for fighting with one's life$(br2)$(effect)Desperate Struggle: $()The lower your health, the higher your attack power
This elixir is most skilled at gathering spiritual energy around the body. After taking it, spiritual energy lingers around you without dispersing, making everything you do twice as effective. It is truly a helpful treasure for improving cultivation$(br2)$(effect)XP Boost: $()Increases the amount of XP gained
This elixir has extremely overbearing medicinal power. After taking it, you gain incomparable strength like a divine dragon. Every move you make carries the power to shake mountains and move the earth, making it a domineering elixir for defeating thousands of enemies
This elixir is most skilled at nourishing vitality. After taking it, it not only quickly restores lost health but also expands the limit of your lifespan, making your body stronger and stronger. It is truly a top-tier elixir for strengthening the foundation, replenishing vitality, and enhancing life force
This elixir has fierce medicinal power. After taking it, you gain the strength of a fierce beast, capable of destroying everything in your path and turning the tide of battle. It can be said to be a top-tier elixir that overwhelms opponents with sheer strength
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.shui_huan_da: This elixir is most skilled at enhancing water-related abilities. After taking it, you can not only breathe freely underwater but also swim much faster, making it a useful elixir for activities in water
This elixir is most skilled at utilizing the power of the earth. After taking it, you can dive into the earth and move freely through it, as smoothly as a fish swimming in water. It is truly a magical elixir for activities underground
This elixir is most fond of killing to increase strength. After taking it, the more creatures you kill, the stronger your own power becomes, making it a domineering elixir for fighting in bloody battles$(br2)$(effect)Asura: $()The more creatures you kill, the higher your attack power
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.hui_guang_da: This elixir is extremely unique. After taking it, if you suffer a lethal injury, you will not die immediately—it saves you from the brink of death. However, if you cannot fully restore your vitality and blood, once the true essence of returning light is exhausted, your soul will return to the underworld with no chance of redemption. It can be said to be a special elixir that fights for a glimmer of hope in desperate situations$(br2)$(effect)Lingering Vitality: $()When taking lethal damage, you won't die and your health locks at 1 HP. You must restore to full health before the effect ends; otherwise, you will die once the effect expires
patchouli.dandao.book.template.alchemy_f: Required Medicinal Properties: %s$(br)Minimum Level: %s$(br)Maximum Level: %s$(br)Required Temperature: Level %s$(br)Required Time: %s Incense Sticks
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.xiao_yao_wan: This pill embodies the Dao of freedom. After taking it, a gentle breeze seems to lift your body, and your steps become as light and agile as walking on floating clouds
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.bi_xie_san.t: This powder embodies spiritual power that wards off evil and purifies turbidity, capable of neutralizing all kinds of evil toxins
This elixir contains true crimson flame patterns. After taking it, even the raging waves of fire that can burn mountains and boil seas will only turn into tiny sparks beside you, unable to harm you in the slightest
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.duan_hun_san: Although this powder is named "Soul-Severing", it actually allows people to linger on the edge of death. However, if you cannot fully restore your vitality and blood in a short time, your seven souls and six spirits will eventually perish. It can be said to be a substance that mixes fortune and misfortune, with nine deaths and one life$(br2)$(effect)Lingering Vitality: $()When taking lethal damage, you won't die and your health locks at 1 HP. You must restore to full health before the effect ends; otherwise, you will die once the effect expires
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.hei_xi_dan.t: This elixir embodies the profound light of the netherworld. After taking it, your eyes seem to be infused with the spiritual light of the night, allowing you to see through darkness as clearly as in broad daylight
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.hui_sheng_da: This elixir has mild medicinal power and contains fleeting revival profound energy. After taking it, the exhausted vitality in your body can suddenly surge, and the lost health can be temporarily replenished
This elixir embodies the spiritual charm of the green abyss. After taking it, it seems as if breathing orifices of the water palace are formed in your nose and mouth. Like a fish in water, you can move as smoothly as on land even at the bottom of the green abyss
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.sui_xing_dan: This elixir contains the tiny power of shattered star fragments. After taking it, your limbs and bones seem to be infused with the energy of star sand refinement. Although it cannot shake mountains, it can add a bit of stone-breaking power to your strength, making every move more fierce
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.wu_shi_san.t: This powder is refined from the spiritual stones of five directions. After taking it, you seem to enter a paradise on earth—you will become more cheerful, your physical strength will increase, and you will laugh off all the hardships and pains in the world
patchouli.dandao.book.entry.xing_jun_san: This powder embodies the tiny true meaning of the Grain-Avoiding Dao. After taking it, even if you travel thousands of miles and go without food for a long time, you will not feel hungry, and your energy will remain as usual
